universe: Nasdaq screener top 150 market-cap names; point-in-time price>=5, ADV20>=10m, history>=252

change: Separate development, validation and forward evidence; classify 60-day factor stability; measure pairwise factor redundancy; formalize minimum market-data contract
result: 12-1 momentum, 6-1 momentum and trend quality pass the preliminary development/validation rule; all remain research-only
known_limitations: forward sample has only four completed month-end observations

change: Expand current-stock universe and history; add RSI, MACD strength, ADX, volume expansion, 52-week breakout, volatility contraction, and relative strength versus SPY
coverage: 436 stocks loaded, 42,825 eligible month-end observations, August 2017 through August 2026
result: 12-1 momentum, 6-1 momentum, trend quality and six-month relative strength pass the preliminary 60-day rule; relative strength overlaps heavily with trend and momentum
known_limitations: historical window remains under ten years
public feed is not a licensed institutional backtest dataset

change: Extend adjusted price history to January 2000 and explicitly test whether recent factor conclusions persist across the longer sample
coverage: 436 stocks loaded, 96,814 eligible month-end observations, January 2001 through August 2026
result: No factor meets the current higher-weight rule over the full development and validation test; the apparent recent strength of momentum and trend does not remain strong enough over the full sample
known_limitations: free chart feed is exploratory rather than institutional research data

change: Apply tradability filters before ranking, SPY EMA200 long-regime gate, next-open execution contract, and within-sector factor ranking
coverage: 435 stocks loaded, 40,523 eligible stock-month observations, April 2003 through August 2026
result: No factor meets the higher-weight rule after safeguards; 12-month momentum and volatility contraction remain weak positive associations, not validated trading factors
known_limitations: Roll spread estimate is not a true bid-ask spread
sector labels are current rather than point-in-time
no commissions or historical quote-level slippage
